text:
"What happened to you?"

Jimmy Uso isn't trying to hear what @SamiZayn has to say... 😮‍💨 https://t.co/hUcUxYMX7f

transcript.text: I did it. I did it. It's here. It's real. And I thought you, more than anyone, would understand where I'm coming from.
Me? Yeah, you. Why? Why? Why? Because it was you. You were the one who made me honorary Ruth before Roman ever did.
You had my back before any of those other guys. You did. But guess what? You're also the same guy.
When push came to shove, you were always the one who pulled the trigger first.
When my time with the bloodline was done, you pulled the trigger. When Solo went too far,
it was you who pulled the trigger. When Roman pushed Jay too far, it was you. It was always you.
When push came to shove, I did what I had to do. I did exactly what I had to do.
Exactly. What do you think I'm doing? What do you think I'm doing, Jimmy? I'm doing what I have to do.
I'm doing what I need to do to get the respect that I deserve. Man, what happened to you, huh?
